title: Minnesota climate-finance awards (compiled)
description: Real awarded climate-finance projects in Minnesota, indexed by reaching-money route (rollup) and the four Concept Note Builder axes (funder, category, region, instrument). Manufactured by compiling public funder award announcements — not an ingested external dataset. Staging lane: not yet vetted through dataset-review. See collection.md for provenance and sources.yaml for the source registry.
grain: one row per awarded project (or per publicly published award line)

scope.in_scope: Routes A (competitive grants) and B (SRF pipeline) — fully. Minnesota, ~2025-2026. Includes the full 2026 Clean Water SRF PPL (Exhibit 4, 333 ranked) and fundable-range IUP with Net SRF loan + subsidy (Exhibit 1, 135 projects), reconciled to published totals. Plus a first energy/buildings slice: Route D (MnCIFA green-bank, 10 closed loans) and program-level aggregates for Route C (EECBG formula) and CERTs seed grants.
scope.not_yet_in_scope: Routes E-F (bonding, muni bonds, PACE). Per-project MnCIFA loan amounts (portfolio stats only). Full EECBG per-city allocations and CERTs per-project rows (aggregates only). The ratepayer/tax-credit stack (CIP/ECO utility rebates, IRA elective/direct pay) — mechanisms, in the landscape doc, not enumerable as awards. Per-column SRF subsidy split. Drinking Water SRF. Historical rounds.
scope.complete_when: For each in-scope funder, every award line in the target round is present with a source-read amount, and all derived fields are computed by a documented rule rather than hand-assigned.

field_provenance_legend.sourced: read directly from a primary source document (verifiable against source_url)
field_provenance_legend.derived: assigned by the compiler's judgment, NOT stated in the source — treat as lower-trust until a deterministic rule is defined
field_provenance_legend.derived-by-rule: computed by an explicit, auditable rule/lookup (not per-row judgment); still not from the award source, but reproducible and correctable in one place

fields.name: route
fields.notes: Rollup index. Derived from funder + instrument via the six-route model in the landscape doc; not stated on the award page.

fields.name: funder
fields.notes: Administering program, as named by the source.

fields.name: category
fields.notes: Assigned from program + project description. energy = solar/geothermal/storage/efficiency; buildings = building-efficiency & efficient housing. Needs a deterministic mapping rule before promotion.

fields.name: region
fields.notes: MN-metro = recipient in the 7-county Twin Cities metro (Anoka, Carver, Dakota, Hennepin, Ramsey, Scott, Washington) or the Metropolitan Council/MCES; MN-greater = everything else; MN = statewide aggregate. Assigned via the auditable positive-list lookup references/mn-region-lookup.csv (one row per distinct recipient, with county + confidence; straddlers flagged 'review'). Not stated in the award source.

fields.name: instrument
fields.notes: From the program's known instrument type.

fields.name: recipient_type
fields.notes: Evident from recipient name; light judgment on edge cases.

fields.name: amount_usd
fields.notes: The award/loan amount. For on-IUP rows this is the Net SRF loan (below-market). For on-PPL rows it is null (Exhibit 4 gives estimated cost only). null also where only a round total is public (DNR per-project).

fields.name: cost_share_pct
fields.notes: Program cap (e.g. DNR up to 50%), not necessarily the realized share.

fields.name: status
fields.notes: Route A: awarded/funded/recommended. Route B pipeline: on-PPL (ranked, Exhibit 4), on-IUP-fundable (fundable range, Exhibit 1), on-IUP-nonfundable (Part C). Route D: funded (closed loan). Route C: on-formula (formula allocation).

fields.name: verified
fields.notes: true = figure read directly from a primary source in this pass (and, for BWSR, cross-checked against published subtotals).

fields.name: ppl_rank
fields.notes: Route B only. The project's rank on the 2026 Clean Water PPL (priority order). The rank IS the datable funding-order status a concept note targets.

fields.name: priority_points
fields.notes: Route B only. MPCA priority score (Minn. R. 7077) behind the rank.

fields.name: project_ref
fields.notes: Route B only. MPCA project number (2xxxxx), or full project ID (2xxxxx-PSxx) for IUP rows.

fields.name: iup_part
fields.notes: Route B IUP (Exhibit 1) rows only. Fundable-A / Fundable-B = inside the SFY2026 fundable range; Nonfundable-C1/C2/C3 = below cutoff or withdrawn.

fields.name: notes
fields.notes: Free text: location context, caveats, cross-references.

promotion_path: compile -> dataset-review (lock scope, replace derived fields with deterministic rules, fill amount gaps from primary sources, complete provenance) -> catalog + pipeline -> modelled.* / CA microservice get_projects().
